_readme: Measured or assumed game constants the simulator depends on. Every entry carries verified:true only after an in-game practice-mode measurement (record date + method in source). The harness lists unverified fixtures on every run and refuses to stamp any artifact 'Proven' while a constant it used is unverified. See docs/v5-engine-design.md, component A.

mitigation.source: Assumed standard K=100 (damage*100/(100+armor)); shipped default stays 100. DATA WARNING 2026-06-12: implied K from total_damage_mitigated rises 122->150 with armor (n=23k players), meaning the field includes shields/DR and the formula cannot be verified from aggregates; if true K > 100, current EHP outputs OVERVALUE armor. range [100,150] is swept by the robustness check (src/robustness.ts) to flag picks that depend on the unknown. Measure in practice mode (highest-priority measurement). PRACTICE MODE 2026-10-15 (maintainer, patch 1.17.2), point 1 of 3: Gideon L1, no items, Void Breach rank 1 hits 95 on minions and the river buff (0 magical armor, so raw = 95) and 72 on the Steel bot at L1 (magical armor 31, data/catalog/heroes.json). K=100 predicts 95*100/131 = 72.5 -> 72 shown; implied K = 97..102 given integer display. Consistent with K=100; two more armor values needed before flipping verified (CALIBRATION-CHECKLIST.md section 1). Point 2 of 3: Steel bot L4 (magical armor 34.3) took 70; K=100 predicts 70.7. Both points sit just under the prediction, consistent with the damage number being rounded DOWN. Point 3: Steel bot L5 (magical armor 35.5) took 70; K=100 predicts 70.1. All three points match K=100 exactly under round-down display (K=95 gives 71/69, K=105 gives 73/71). NOT yet flipped to verified: the three points span only 31-35.5 armor, and the 2026-06-12 data warning is about HIGH armor (implied K rising toward 150). One reading at ~50+ magical armor (Steel L15+ ~ 63 expected, L18 ~ 60) before flipping. Point 4: Steel bot L6 (magical armor 36.8) took 69; K=100 predicts 69.4. VERIFIED 2026-10-15 by maintainer decision on the four points above (all within display rounding of K=100); the high-armor (50+) reading was waived. If a later high-armor measurement disagrees, reopen.

percentPenMultiplicative.source: Patch 1.14 notes: percent armor penetration now multiplicative (predecessorgame.com, May 19 2026).

abilityHaste.source: Assumed LoL-style ability haste. Measure: Timewarp + known-CD ability, stopwatch. PRACTICE MODE 2026-10-15 (maintainer, patch 1.17.2), point 1: Gideon L8, no items, stats panel shows 6 ability haste; Cosmic Rift rank 1 (base 12s per data/catalog) tooltip shows 11s. Formula predicts 12*100/106 = 11.3s; tooltip shows whole seconds, so consistent. Integer display limits precision; need ~20 and ~60 AH readings (expect 10.0s and 7.5s). Point 2: 20 AH -> tooltip 10s; formula predicts 10.0s exactly. A flat-percent alternative (12*(1-AH/100)) predicts 9.6s, which a whole-second tooltip cannot separate from 10; the ~60 AH reading (formula 7.5s vs flat 4.8s) separates them cleanly, so verified waits for it. Point 3: 61 AH -> tooltip 7s; formula predicts 7.45s (flat-percent alternative 4.7s, ruled out). VERIFIED 2026-10-15 at AH 6/20/61.

critMultiplier.source: Assumed 1.75. DATA EVIDENCE 2026-06-12: largest_critical_strike envelope over 6,657 crit builders, densest ratio bins 1.6-1.8 under bonus-only scaling (consistent with 1.75; confounded by crit-damage modifiers and possible post-mitigation recording). range [1.6,1.8] is swept by the robustness check. Confirm in practice mode. PRACTICE MODE 2026-10-15 (maintainer, patch 1.17.2), point 1: Murdock, same bot, no items: basic hit 43 (twice); with Onixian Quiver (20% crit, NO physical power; Multishot side projectiles read separately; Onixia is melee-only) a crit showed 72. Ratio 1.674; with round-down display the true multiplier lies in 72/44..73/43 = 1.636..1.698, so the assumed 1.75 (would show 75) is RULED OUT. value left at 1.75 and verified false until a larger-number reading pins it (bigger base hit = tighter bound). Points 2-3: 41 -> 68 (1.619..1.683) and 107 -> 177 (1.639..1.664). All three ranges intersect at 1.639..1.664: VERIFIED 2026-10-15, value 1.65 (was assumed 1.75; crit-built damage was overstated ~6% per crit).

attackSpeedFormula.formula: MEASURED 2026-10-15: attacksPerSecond = (base_attack_speed[level] * (1 + item_attack_speed / 100)) / basic_attack_time. The sim still computes the old form (no / basic_attack_time); verified flips when the sim fix lands.
attackSpeedFormula.source: Assumed. base_stats.attack_speed is per-level attacks/sec (omeda.city heroes.json); item attack_speed treated as percent. PRACTICE MODE 2026-10-15 (maintainer, patch 1.17.2), point 1: Murdock, no attack-speed items, stats panel 125% attack speed; counted 18 attacks in 20s = 0.90/s. The CURRENT formula reads 125% as 1.25 attacks/s (37% too fast). Murdock's basic_attack_time is 1.45 (data/catalog/heroes.json); attack_speed / basic_attack_time = 1.25 / 1.45 = 0.86/s (17.2 per 20s) fits within counting error. Hypothesis to confirm with a +attack-speed reading: attacksPerSecond = attack_speed% / 100 / basic_attack_time. Point 2: panel 180%, 26 swings in 20s = 25 intervals = 1.25/s; attack_speed/BAT = 1.80/1.45 = 1.24/s (point 1 re-read the same way: 17 intervals = 0.85/s vs 0.86). CONFIRMED: attacksPerSecond = panelAttackSpeed / basic_attack_time. The shipped formula (1.80/s) is ~45% fast for Murdock. Sim fix pending: apply to every hero except Legion (BAT 0.2, minigun) and Revenant (level-varying BAT, reload), which need their own check. Point 3 (stacked attack speed): panel 474%, 64 swings in 20s (3.15..3.2/s); panel/BAT predicts 4.74/1.45 = 3.27/s. Formula holds at the top end too.

abilityScalingUsesBonusPowerOnly.source: base_stats.physical_power equals the basic-attack per-level damage line. DATA EVIDENCE 2026-06-12: the crit envelope is only plausible under bonus-only scaling (mode 1.6-1.8); total-power reading implies an absurd 1.2x crit multiplier. Confirm in practice mode. PRACTICE MODE 2026-10-15 (maintainer, patch 1.17.2), basic-attack reading, INCONCLUSIVE: Murdock panel 61 physical power hit a bot for 41 (bot keeps 0.672..0.689); with +100 item power (panel 161) the hit was 107, i.e. raw ~155..159. The tooltip's '+85%' on bonus power predicts raw 146 (98..100 shown), on total power ~198 (133..136); 100% of bonus (raw 161, 108..111) is nearest. Open: the two items' passives and whether the bot levelled between hits. Not a verdict on ability scaling; needs a Grux Crush reading (checklist section 5). RESOLVED same day: all hits were on the Steel bot at L3 (same armor), so the ratio is armor-free: 107/41 = 2.61 (2.548..2.634 with integer display). Ratio on TOTAL power predicts 3.24 -> ruled out; the ratio applies to BONUS (item) power: VERIFIED 2026-10-15 (Murdock, Mesmer + Tyranny = +100 physical power, no damage passives). Evidence is a basic attack; ability ratios are taken to follow the same rule. SIDE FINDING: the implied coefficient is ~0.93..0.98 of item power, not the tooltip's +85% (which predicts 2.39). The sim reads ratios from tooltip text, so Murdock's basic damage with items may be understated ~10%; one hero, flagged, not generalised.

ultRankLevels.source: VERIFIED 2026-06-12 from pred.gg recommendedSkills (in-game data): 18-entry skill orders place ULTIMATE at positions 6/11/16 for gideon, greystone, sparrow.

maxLevel.source: 18-entry base stat arrays across all heroes (omeda.city heroes.json, patch 1.14.4).

attackSpeedCap.crossCheck: Maintainer web research (2026-06-14) cites a 350-420% attack-speed cap. That is a percent-bonus figure, whereas the shipped 3.0 is an absolute attacks/sec ceiling from the Cursed Ring tooltip; the two are likely the same limit seen two ways (base AS x cap ~= 3/sec for most heroes). Shipped value left at 3.0 (stronger in-game source); confirm the units in practice mode before reconciling.
attackSpeedCap.source: STATED in item data: Cursed Ring (Broken Chains) reads "Increase the Attacks per Second Cap from 3 to 4", so the default cap is 3.0 attacks/sec (4.0 with that effect, currently unmodeled). Applied 2026-06-14 from the stated value; the formula interaction still merits a practice-mode check (checklist 7), so it stays verified:false (output remains THEORY). PRACTICE MODE 2026-10-15: Murdock at panel 474% swung 64 times in 20s (3.15..3.2/s; panel/BAT predicts 3.27/s) WHILE HOLDING CURSED RING, which raises the cap to 4.0 — so the reading is consistent with the shipped 3.0 base cap and confirms the ring lifts it past 3. To verify the base cap: same stack WITHOUT Cursed Ring should read exactly ~60 swings in 20s (3.0/s). Note: with attacks/s now divided by basic attack time, the cap binds only at very high attack speed.

checkpoints._note: Minute -> typical level and item gold by role. GOLD is MEASURED: per-role medians from a live match sample, re-derived on data refresh, data/aggregates/2026-10-14.json (pred.gg, patch 1.17.2, pvp+ranked, 3459 matches). Minute = TRUE game minute: pred.gg's per-minute gold array has no pregame padding (length = match duration in minutes), unlike the retired omeda feed, whose ~3 leading pregame entries made every earlier table read ~3 minutes late (omeda 'minute 10' 2504 carry gold = pred.gg minute 7, 2511). LEVELS remain PROVISIONAL: neither feed has a level timeline (autonomy policy rule: flagged, not estimated).
checkpoints.goldSource: data/aggregates/2026-10-14.json (npm run aggregate, pred.gg, pvp+ranked, patch 1.17.2)
checkpoints.goldEconomyNote: Measured in the 1.17.2 window, after the 1.16 economy rework; replaces the 1.15 omeda table (which also read ~3 minutes late).

referenceProfiles._note: Enemy defense profiles for damage objectives, level-13 ballpark: squishy = mage/carry base armor + no defense items; bruiser = fighter base + one defensive item; tank = warden base + two defensive items + HP. Derived from omeda.city base_stats at level 13.

neutralObjectives._note: Neutral jungle-objective profiles for solo-clear feasibility (can a jungler take it alone, and at what level/items). UNVERIFIED placeholders pending practice-mode measurement of HP, armor, and contact damage per second; output stays THEORY. Add real values + verified:true after measuring.
